description: Defines classes, structs, and functions related to BBRv2 congestion control algorithm in QUIC, including limits, parameters, network model, congestion events, and mode management.

classes.name: Limits
classes.description: Template class representing min/max limits for a value.

classes.name: Bbr2Params
classes.description: Contains all parameters for Bbr2Sender, including startup, drain, probe_bw, probe_rtt modes, and experimental flags.

classes.name: RoundTripCounter
classes.description: Tracks the number of round trips and last sent packet.

classes.name: MinRttFilter
classes.description: Maintains the minimum RTT over a period.

classes.name: Bbr2MaxBandwidthFilter
classes.description: Tracks maximum bandwidth over recent rounds.

classes.name: Bbr2CongestionEvent
classes.description: Holds data about congestion events, including bytes acked/lost, RTT, bandwidth, and packet states.

classes.name: Bbr2NetworkModel
classes.description: Models congestion signals and estimates for BBRv2, including RTT, bandwidth, inflight, and mode transitions.

classes.name: Bbr2Mode
classes.description: Enumeration of BBRv2 modes: STARTUP, DRAIN, PROBE_BW, PROBE_RTT.

classes.name: Bbr2ModeBase
classes.description: Base class for mode-specific behaviors in BBRv2, including entering/exiting modes and handling congestion events.

methods.name: Limits::ApplyLimits
methods.description: Clamps a raw value within min and max limits.

methods.name: Limits::Min
methods.description: Returns the minimum limit.

methods.name: Limits::Max
methods.description: Returns the maximum limit.

methods.name: MinMax
methods.description: Creates a Limits object with specified min and max.

methods.name: NoLessThan
methods.description: Creates Limits with a minimum value and maximum as numeric_limits.

methods.name: NoGreaterThan
methods.description: Creates Limits with a maximum value and minimum as numeric_limits.

methods.name: Unlimited
methods.description: Creates Limits with min and max as the extreme limits.

methods.name: operator<< (Limits)
methods.description: Outputs Limits as [min, max].

methods.name: Bbr2Params constructor
methods.description: Initializes Bbr2Params with cwnd min/max limits.

methods.name: RoundTripCounter::OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates round trip count based on sent packet.

methods.name: RoundTripCounter::OnPacketsAcked
methods.description: Checks if a round trip has completed based on acknowledged packet.

methods.name: MinRttFilter::Update
methods.description: Updates min RTT with a new sample.

methods.name: MinRttFilter::ForceUpdate
methods.description: Forcefully updates min RTT with a new sample.

methods.name: Bbr2MaxBandwidthFilter::Update
methods.description: Updates max bandwidth with a new sample.

methods.name: Bbr2MaxBandwidthFilter::Advance
methods.description: Advances the filter to the next window.

methods.name: Bbr2MaxBandwidthFilter::Get
methods.description: Returns the maximum bandwidth observed.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles packet sent event, updating model state.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::OnCongestionEventStart
methods.description: Handles start of congestion event, updating RTT, bandwidth, inflight.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::UpdateNetworkParameters
methods.description: Updates RTT estimates.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::BDP
methods.description: Calculates Bandwidth-Delay Product.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::MinRtt
methods.description: Returns current minimum RTT.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::MaxBandwidth
methods.description: Returns current max bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: Bbr2NetworkModel::MaybeExpireMinRtt
methods.description: Possibly expires min RTT based on congestion event.

methods.name: operator<< (Bbr2Mode)
methods.description: Outputs mode as string.

methods.name: Bbr2ModeBase::Enter
methods.description: Mode-specific enter logic.

methods.name: Bbr2ModeBase::Leave
methods.description: Mode-specific leave logic.

methods.name: Bbr2ModeBase::OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion event in mode.

methods.name: BytesInFlight
methods.description: Calculates bytes in flight from send state.
